implementation: Flutter tracks remote screen-share publishers after the initial room snapshot, preserves the baseline over reconnect, displays a six-second live-region voice-dock notice for a newly started remote share, and exposes a persisted local sound toggle. Android uses the platform click sound because Flutter does not support its alert sound type there; desktop uses the alert sound type.

checks.name: Tracker initial baseline, new shares, reconnect restoration, and leave reset
checks.observation: All four tracker tests passed, including initial baseline suppression, a new remote publisher, known-track reconnect restoration, and baseline reset after leave.

checks.name: Voice dock notice and persisted sound toggle
checks.command: flutter test test/workspace_screen_test.dart --plain-name "voice dock announces reconnect and deafen transition states"
checks.observation: Widget test confirms the six-second notice is rendered as a live region, the sound control exposes enabled/disabled state, and the disabled preference persists through SharedPreferences.

checks.name: Flutter analysis and full suite
checks.observation: flutter analyze reported no issues; the full Flutter suite passed all 180 tests.

remaining: Verify LiveKit publisher/track events and audible platform system sound on macOS, Windows, and Android against real participants. The native sound is platform-adapted rather than the exact WebAudio chime used by web.
